source: American Heart Association (AHA) / American College of Cardiology (ACC)
document_title: 2017 Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults
section: Classification of Blood Pressure in Adults (Table 6)
guideline_statement: Normal diastolic blood pressure is below 80 mm Hg. Stage 1 hypertension is defined as a diastolic reading of 80–89 mm Hg. Stage 2 hypertension is defined as a diastolic reading of 90 mm Hg or higher. High blood pressure frequently coexists with insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome.
clinical_context: Diastolic blood pressure reflects vascular resistance during cardiac relaxation. Blood pressure values obtained in single visits or screening tools require standardized repeated measurements with calibrated sphygmomanometers before clinical diagnosis.
